programme.title: Charitra Heen
programme.desc: A middle-class man marries a millionaire's daughter despite family opposition. Marital differences arise, and he finds solace with another woman.

programme.title: Trishul
programme.desc: Vijay Kumar, illegitimate son of construction baron Raj Kumar Gupta, seeks revenge after his mother's death. He aims to destroy the Gupta family's business and connections.

programme.title: Deewaar
programme.desc: Brothers Vijay and Ravi Verma, sons of a disgraced unionist, follow different paths: Vijay, a smuggler; Ravi, a cop hunting him. Raised by their poor single mother in Bombay, they face hardships.

programme.title: 3 Deewarein
programme.desc: Filmmaker Chandrika documents three death-row inmates. They open up, sharing stories leading to shocking revelations.

programme.title: Suhaag
programme.desc: Blind writer Sandhya Bhatnagar, with a troubled past, meets a sadistic reporter claiming to be her fan. He coaxes her into revealing her past, leading to shocking truths.

programme.title: Judaai
programme.desc: New student Shiva at VAS College confronts local goons creating nuisance, despite their backing from an influential politician.

programme.title: Chot Aj Isko, Kal Tereko
programme.desc: Elderly noble Ambaprasad, realizing relatives only care for his wealth, discards it and leaves home in search of happiness.

programme.title: Prem Geet
programme.desc: Richest man Vikrant Raina's daughter is kidnapped. The kidnapper demands he complete deadly tasks to settle an old score, not money.

programme.title: Masoom
programme.desc: Asha can't conceive and loses eyesight after trauma. Mother-in-law expels her, arranging Ajay's remarriage, changing everyone's lives.

programme.title: Souten Ki Beti
programme.desc: Shyam lives happily with wife Rukmini. Their life turns upside down when his long-lost love Radha, whom he left impregnated, returns with their daughter.

programme.title: Dil Kya Kare
programme.desc: Kavita hires a caretaker for Neha, but her life turns upside down when the caretaker is revealed to be Neha's biological mother, and Anand the father.

programme.title: Gupt The Hidden Truth
programme.desc: Sahil Sinha loves Isha but his father insists on an arranged marriage. After an argument, Jaisingh dies. Sahil is blamed, jailed, and escapes to find the real killer.

programme.title: Gundaraj
programme.desc: Rai Bahadur's granddaughter Pinky leaves home after a quarrel. She falls for taxi driver Govinda. Just as they're ready to live together, Rai Bahadur gets him arrested.

programme.title: Udhaar Ki Zindagi
programme.desc: Sitaram disowns his son for marrying his choice. Years later, his granddaughter visits with a gift, revealing a shocking truth about her parents' absence.

programme.title: Aap To Aise Na The
programme.desc: Blind Anirudh runs a school for visually impaired kids. He falls for widowed social worker Kavita. When marriage is proposed, Anirudh's inferiority complex takes over.

programme.title: Aulad
programme.desc: Two youngsters, Gopi and Kiran, wronged by powerful men, fall in love and unite to fight for justice.

programme.title: Amrit
programme.desc: A corrupt policeman and greedy builder team up to seize land from Yadav, a Mumbai milk vendor with a cattle farm. Will they succeed?

programme.title: Sangdil Sanam
programme.desc: Poor farmer's son Ravi works for a wealthy landowner. Ravi runs against the tyrant in village elections, incurring the landowner's wrath.

programme.title: Imaandaar
programme.desc: A loyal village bumpkin gets a city hotel job. He realizes his boss's life is threatened and protects him, uncovering shocking revelations.

programme.title: Jigariyaa
programme.desc: Good-for-nothing poet Shaamu falls for well-educated do-gooder Raadha. Just as they grow fond, cruel circumstances tear them apart.

programme.title: Humko Tumse Pyaar Hai
programme.desc: A blind girl loses her lover after regaining sight. She meets & accepts a new man, but her former lover then returns.

programme.title: Majboor
programme.desc: Wealthy Mr. Rai is attacked, rescued by Anand. Anand is injured, nursed by Rai's wife Shobha. Rai trusts Anand, making him Chief Supervisor, unaware of his hidden agenda.

programme.title: Pyar Hi Pyar
programme.desc: Dr. Shashikant marries Gauri to fulfill his dying father's wish. Misunderstandings separate them. The story follows their individual lives and their two children.

programme.title: Jaali Note
programme.desc: Inspector Dinesh is assigned to stop the recent flood of counterfeit currency notes in Mumbai. He goes undercover & during investigation, he becomes romantically involved with a female reporter and makes a discovery of shocking personal significance.

programme.title: Sp Chauhan: A Struggling Man
programme.desc: This biopic traces Thakur Satpal Chauhan's journey, a Haryana social worker who bravely promoted women's empowerment & an alcohol-free society.

programme.title: Judaai

programme.title: Ek Hi Raasta

programme.title: Dil Vil Pyar Vyar
